title: 2024 Topps Blue Foil #415 Rob Refsnyder Boston Red Sox Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2024 Topps Series 2 sports trading card features Rob Refsnyder of the Boston Red Sox. The card is a blue foil parallel variety with a card number of 415 out of 999. It is a great addition to any collection for fans of baseball and the Major League (MLB). The card is not autographed and is manufactured by Topps. Enjoy the thrill of collecting with this 2024 Topps Series 2 Rob Refsnyder Blue Foil Parallel card.
